english.note: Use this when bypass means skipping the normal steps or channels rather than physically going around something.

examples.english: They bypass the procedure to approve the application quickly, and end up causing complaints.
examples.traditional: 佢哋為咗盡快批出申請，跳過程序，結果惹起投訴。
